title: Scene 1 - THE PARABLE - INT. Classroom - Day | LIGHT: Day int, big north-facing classroom windows camera-left + overhead tubelights off, soft and mid key (4:1), neutral 5600K, clean and plain: the one place Mamta is in control

shots.desc: Top-down macro on dry sand: a small insect wanders aimlessly, leaving a crooked trail behind it.
shots.light: Window light raking low across the sand from camera-left, soft, 5600K, long thin shadows give every grain texture; the trail reads as a dark line
shots.notes: Opening image: a life with no straight path. Cold, desaturated grade from frame one. Crooked trail match-cuts to palm lines in Shot 2.
shots.audio: Ambience: faint wind over sand, distant classroom murmur

shots.desc: A small girl's open palm, lines stretched across it; beside it her other hand is clenched in a fist resting on a wooden desk.
shots.light: Same window rake across the desk, soft 5600K, palm lines picked out by side light, fist slightly darker on the shadow side
shots.notes: MATCH CUT from Shot 1: same top-down framing, trail becomes palm lines (fate). MOTIF: HANDS/FISTS begins.
shots.audio: MAMTA (V.O.): 'Raaste mein ek chote se paudhe ko dekh Shishya ne Mahavir se pucha-'

shots.desc: The girl's fist opens, revealing a candy. She dangles it to tease her friend.
shots.light: Soft window side light, a small specular glint on the candy wrapper as the fist opens; the only bright point in frame
shots.notes: PLANT: a fist that opens to give pays off in Shot 161, where Mamta's fist fails and lets go.
shots.audio: MAMTA (V.O.) (cont.): '"Gurudev! Ye bataiye ki iss paudhe par phool aayega, ya nahi?".'

shots.desc: Two small girls at a shared desk; one snatches at the candy, the other pulls it away, giggling silently.
shots.light: Window key camera-left at 45°, soft 5600K, 3:1, white bounce under the desks lifts the children's faces: lightness
shots.notes: Children are the only lightness in the film. Keep them in natural window light.
shots.audio: MAMTA (V.O.) (cont.): 'Mahavir kuch der chup chaap paudhe ko dekhte rahe, phir bole- "Haan! iss paudhe par phool aayega."'

shots.desc: Classroom from the back row: rows of students, Mamta (35) standing at the front leaning on the teacher's table, an open book in her hand, narrating.
shots.light: Windows camera-left as broad soft key across the rows, 5600K, mid key, back wall a stop darker for depth, Mamta at the table lit by the nearest window
shots.notes: VO becomes sync: reveal of the narrator. The classroom is the only place Mamta is in control. PLANT: the Mahavir parable is the film's spine; it pays off in the final shot, Shot 212.
shots.audio: MAMTA: 'Ye sunte hi Shishya ne paudhe ko ukhaad kar phenk diya, phir hass kar bola- "Ab kaise phool khilega!"'

shots.desc: Mamta chuckles and acts it out: her hands grip an invisible plant and yank it out of the ground.
shots.light: Window key at 45° camera-left, soft 5600K, 4:1, a bounce right keeps her animated and readable
shots.notes: The uprooting gesture is her own life story, told as a joke. Hold the gesture fully in frame.
shots.audio: MAMTA: (chuckles & enacts) 'Mahavir kuch nahi bole, bas muskura kar aage badh gaye.'

shots.desc: Mamta continues the story, warming to it.
shots.light: Window key 45° camera-left with a 4x4 diffusion frame, 5600K, 4:1, catchlight at 10 o'clock: the 85mm portrait light that defines her
shots.notes: 85mm isolates her from the class: her lens for the whole film.
shots.audio: MAMTA: 'Phir kuch din bohot tezz baarish hui, toh unhe wahin gaav mein rukna pada. Jab saat din baad, ussi raste se guzre, toh dekha-'

shots.desc: A knock. A peon stands in the doorway holding folders and papers.
shots.light: Doorway backlit by the bright corridor (about +1 stop), peon partly silhouetted; Mamta's shoulder in soft window light: the outside world as a hard edge
shots.notes: Over Mamta's shoulder: the outside world interrupts the story.
shots.audio: SFX: knock at the door. PEON: 'Ma'am koi aaye hain, aapse milne.'

shots.desc: Mamta answers without asking who it is.
shots.light: Same key as the earlier MCU, 4:1; she half turns away from the window so the shadow side grows slightly on 'aati hoon'
shots.notes: She doesn't ask who: she already suspects. A flicker of tension before she resets.
shots.audio: MAMTA: 'Staff room mein bithao, aati hoon.'

shots.desc: Mamta returns to the story, leaning in to the class.
shots.light: Same window key, 4:1; as she leans in the key falls more frontal, eyes fully lit
shots.notes: Same framing as the shot before the knock: she resumes as if nothing happened.
shots.audio: MAMTA: 'Haan, toh dekha ki jahan mitti ukhaad kar phenki thi, wahan ek bohot bada phool khila hua hai. Toh shishya ekdum hairaan hogaye, "Ye kaise hua?"'

shots.desc: Students listening with utmost attention; slow pan across rapt faces.
shots.light: Even soft window light across the children's faces, 5600K, 3:1, a white floor bounce: rapt and open
shots.notes: Rapt silence; the room is with her.
shots.audio: Ambience: ceiling fan hum, pages turning

shots.desc: Mamta's face lit with hope and confidence as she reaches the moral.
shots.light: Key brightened half a stop and warmed (4300K, a CTO-quarter on the bounce), ratio opens to 3:1, strong catchlight: hope, the warmest present-day beat
shots.notes: The light warms one notch: the only warm beat in the present day before the sunrise. The moral is cut off and never spoken; the film itself is the answer (Shot 212).

shots.desc: From a student's desk height, looking up at Mamta as an unseen student asks his question.
shots.light: From desk height, the window behind her shoulder adds a slight rim, face a touch under-exposed against the brighter window: authority wavering
shots.notes: The child's question is the film's question: why was she uprooted?
shots.audio: STUDENT (O.S.): 'Par Ma'am, Shishya ne paudha ukhaad kar phenka hi kyun?'

shots.desc: Mamta's smile slowly fades; her eyes stay fixed on the child, frozen.
shots.light: The bounce is pulled away during the push-in (cutter fades the fill), ratio drifts from 3:1 to 6:1, catchlight dims: the warmth drains as the question lands
shots.notes: PLANT: the unanswered 'why' pays off in Shot 205 ('humne tujhe daav par laga diya'). Room tone drains out under her.
shots.audio: SFX: room tone drops to silence

shots.desc: The school bell, ringing hard on a corridor wall.
shots.light: Flat soft corridor daylight on the bell, a cold 5600K, a hard metal specular
shots.notes: Hard cut on the sound: it breaks her freeze.

shots.desc: Mamta awkwardly gathers her book and things and heads for the door as students stir.
shots.light: Back to the even 4:1 window key, slightly cooler (5600K, warm bounce removed): the class reset
shots.notes: She leaves the parable unfinished.
shots.audio: MAMTA: 'Baaki ka agli class mein karenge.'

title: Scene 2 - THE SUMMONS - INT. Outside Staff Room - Day | LIGHT: Day int school corridor, daylight from open arches at the far end + one staff-room window, soft but contrasty (6:1), cool 6000K, shadows pool along the corridor: the past waiting in a room

shots.desc: School corridor: Mamta walks toward the staff room, books against her chest.
shots.light: Gimbal walk through alternating pools of soft arch light and shadow, 6000K; her face passes in and out of the light
shots.notes: Gimbal leads her: she walks into something she can't see yet.

shots.desc: Her feet stop dead at the staff-room threshold.
shots.light: Hard daylight slash across the threshold floor, her feet stop exactly on the edge of light
shots.notes: Feet stopping is her recurring reflex (repeats in Shots 22 and 166).

shots.desc: Through the doorframe: a man in his fifties seated inside, his back to the door.
shots.light: Inside the staff room a window behind the man backlights him, his back silhouetted with a soft rim, face unseen, 5600K: withheld
shots.notes: WITHHOLD Papa's face: back only, until Shot 23. Doorframe = BARS/FRAMES motif.

shots.desc: Mamta turns away, leans on the wall next to the door for a breath, then walks off in the opposite direction.
shots.light: She leans on the wall in shadow, only an edge of corridor light on her profile, 8:1: hiding
shots.notes: She chooses to flee. Hold the wall lean in silence.

shots.desc: Down the corridor from behind Mamta as she walks away; a voice calls after her.
shots.light: Long corridor in depth, bright arch at the far end, Mamta a dark figure walking toward it
shots.notes: Wide and empty: the corridor makes her small.

shots.desc: Mamta's feet stop; she slowly turns around.
shots.light: She turns into a soft side light from the corridor window, 6:1, half face in shadow
shots.notes: Feet-stop reflex, second time (see Shot 18).

shots.desc: Papa walks toward her, his face finally seen: pleading.
shots.light: Papa walks into the soft corridor light, face revealed, 5600K, 4:1, eyes lit: pleading made visible
shots.notes: REVEAL of Shot 19. He looks older and smaller than she remembers.

shots.desc: Mamta bends and touches his feet; he looks down at her.
shots.light: Even soft top light from the corridor, both in the same light for once, 4:1
shots.notes: Ritual respect survives the hurt. Play the pause before she bends.

shots.desc: Over Papa's shoulder onto Mamta, firm but breaking.
shots.light: Window light on Mamta's face from camera-right, 5:1, catchlight present, Papa's shoulder dark in the foreground
shots.notes: Standard OTS pair; keep the eyeline tight.
shots.audio: MAMTA: 'Agar aap mujhe le jaane aaye hai, toh mujhe maaf kar dijiye papa. Mein wapas uss ghar nahi-'

shots.desc: Over Mamta's shoulder onto Papa.
shots.light: Reverse: Papa's face in slightly flatter, greyer light, 4:1, Mamta's shoulder dark foreground: tired and old
shots.notes: He cuts her off; he still does.
shots.audio: PAPA: 'Mere paas aur koi raasta nahi hai beta..'

title: Scene 3 - HOMECOMING - EXT. House - Day | LIGHT: Day ext small-town lane, overcast midday, soft top light, cool 6500K, low contrast and grey; the house front in shade, colourless

shots.desc: Deep frame: a tuk-tuk in the foreground, Mamta pulling luggage out with her back to camera; at the far end of the lane the house, Papa walking into it.
shots.light: Overcast sky as a giant soft box, 6500K, the house sits in shadow at the end of the lane, a stop under the foreground: closed and grey
shots.notes: First look at the house: a closed shape at the end of the frame, seen past her back. 2.39 width used for distance. PLANT: this exact framing returns as the wedding night in Shot 29.
shots.audio: Ambience: small-town lane, tuk-tuk engine pulling away

shots.desc: Luggage on her shoulder, Mamta turns toward the house.
shots.light: Soft overcast top light, a neg-fill flag on the house side deepens her shadow side during the push-in, 5:1
shots.notes: The push-in carries us into memory. Sound bridge: distant shehnai fades in before the cut.

title: Scene 4 - FLASH: BIDAAI - EXT. House - Night / Day (cont.) | LIGHT: Night ext wedding (flash): strings of tungsten fairy lights + a decorated car's bulbs, warm 2700K, hard little sources, festive yet harsh; then a hard cut back to the grey day

shots.desc: The same frame at night: the house in wedding lights, a small car decorated with flowers and lights, relatives in wedding clothes, Mamta in a red bridal lehenga at the door with her parents.
shots.light: Same frame at night: the house outlined in fairy-light strings, 2700K, practical bulbs on the car, deep blue night sky (7000K) above: warmth that is only decoration
shots.notes: SAME FRAMING as Shot 27: the flash changes the time, not the camera. Achieve it in camera by matching the tripod mark. MOTIF: RED, the first full red in the film.
shots.audio: Music: shehnai; muffled weeping of relatives

shots.desc: Mamta in bridal makeup among tearful relatives: no happiness, no sadness, a dead expression.
shots.light: Fairy-light bokeh behind, a warm 2700K top-side key that is unflattering, no eye light, flat dead eyes: a dead face in festive light
shots.notes: PLANT: this blank face is mirrored in the river, Shot 206.

shots.desc: Her hennaed hands throw fistfuls of raw rice back over her head toward the house.
shots.light: Backlit by the wedding strings, the rice grains catch specular sparkle in slow motion, 2700K
shots.notes: Bidaai ritual: she returns what the house gave. MOTIF: HANDS.

shots.desc: Daylight again: her bags lie fallen on the dusty ground. A few grains of rice lie near the threshold. Her hand reaches in.
shots.light: Back to flat overcast day 6500K, soft top light on the dusty ground, grains of rice catching faint highlights
shots.notes: Hard sound cut back to day ambience. The rice grains are a practical continuity trace of the flash.

shots.desc: Mamta picks up the bags, walks up to the house and enters the main door.
shots.light: Overcast soft, 6500K; the dark doorway is about -3 stops, so she walks into black
shots.notes: Hold until the door swallows her.

title: Scene 5 - THE SCRAPING - INT. House (Corridor) - Day | LIGHT: Day int corridor, almost no direct light, a single barred window spilling cool daylight, low key (8:1), green-grey 6000K: the house holds its breath

shots.desc: Dim corridor: following Mamta and her bags; a faint, rhythmic scraping begins somewhere ahead.
shots.light: The corridor lit only by spill from the barred window ahead, 6000K, she walks from dark into a pool of light, low key 8:1
shots.notes: PLANT: the scraping sound pays off in Shot 64 (knitting needles carving tally marks). The house is cold and green-grey; no sunlight reaches the corridor.
shots.audio: SFX: faint scraping, metal on wood, rhythmic

shots.desc: Mamta's head turns toward the sound.
shots.light: Window side light on her profile, hard-ish, 6:1, the other side falls to black
shots.notes: Sound leads her; she doesn't choose to remember.

shots.desc: A big barred window off the corridor. Mamta slowly extends her arm and touches the bars.
shots.light: Hard daylight through the window bars throws bar shadows across her arm and chest, 5600K: BARS motif in light
shots.notes: MOTIF: BARS/FRAMES. This window looks into her old room.

shots.desc: Her fingers close around a rusted bar.
shots.light: Bar-shadow stripes across her fingers, a rusty texture under a raking hard light
shots.notes: MOTIF: HANDS.

title: Scene 6 - FLASH: LOCKED IN - INT. House (Mamta's Room) - Day | LIGHT: Day int (flash), Mamta's old room, same window but a green gel on the daylight (Plusgreen), hard, cold 6000K + green, low key: imprisonment

shots.desc: Through the bars, ten years earlier: young Mamta half hidden by the open almirah door, scraping something on the inside of the door; an unfinished red sweater and knitting needles in her hand.
shots.light: Through the bars, her old room in a sickly green-cold light, a hard window key from behind the almirah door, 8:1
shots.notes: Same space, shifted light: greener and colder, done with a practical gel change. MOTIF: RED sweater. SCRIPT FLAG: Sc21 calls the sweater blue; we keep RED for the motif (see Shot 155).

shots.desc: She shuts the almirah door, revealing a big pregnant belly.
shots.light: Hard green-cold side light on her belly as the door shuts, deep shadow behind
shots.notes: REVEAL: the first sign of the pregnancy. Frame chest-down until the door closes.

shots.desc: Young Mamta turns sharply and stares straight at the barred window, into the lens.
shots.light: Hard frontal from the window, green cast, eyes lit, full catchlight staring into the lens: the past sees her
shots.notes: The past looks at the present. Eyeline straight to lens: the only time we break it.

shots.desc: Present Mamta jerks back from the bars, fear on her face.
shots.light: Back in the corridor window light, but the key now on the far side; her face lurches into shadow, 8:1
shots.notes: Handheld only on panic beats, per the Brief.

shots.desc: She hurries out of the corridor toward the drawing room.
shots.light: Corridor low key; she is a dark shape crossing pools of window spill

title: Scene 7 - THE UNCHANGED ROOM - INT. House (Drawing Room) - Day | LIGHT: Day int drawing room, net-curtained windows + one 60W bulb shade practical, soft and dim (6:1), 5600K window vs 3200K bulb mixed, dusty: time has stopped

shots.desc: The drawing room from a corner: dated sofa, cabinet, framed photos. Mamta walks in and stops in the middle.
shots.light: Net-curtain windows camera-right give a soft wash, the bulb practical glows warm in the corner, haze shows dust in the air, 6:1
shots.notes: Establish the drawing room: the arena for Scenes 13, 18, 19, 23 and 25. Nothing has changed in ten years; dress it dusty and dated. PLANT: this framing returns in Shot 116.

shots.desc: Mamta turns slowly where she stands, taking in the details; the camera arcs the opposite way around her.
shots.light: Arc: as she turns, the key moves from window side to shadow side and back across her face: a disorientation done with light
shots.notes: Counter-rotation makes the room spin around her. Muffled voices begin halfway through the turn.

shots.desc: Details exactly as they were: framed family photos, a wall calendar, the cabinet glass.
shots.light: Soft window light on the frames, a dust-haze glow, warm bulb reflections in the photo glass
shots.notes: Voices sound muffled and far away, as if heard through a wall.
shots.audio: MAMTA (V.O., muffled): 'Papa, ye Dev hai! Ye dac-' / MOTHER (V.O.): 'Poora naam kya hai beta..'

shots.desc: The sofa, its cushions sagging.
shots.light: Raking soft window light across the sofa fabric, dust specks visible in haze
shots.notes: PLANT: this sofa is where Dev was 'interviewed'; it pays off in Shot 116.
shots.audio: DEV (V.O.): 'Dev Bhadoria.' / PAPA (V.O.): 'Kaam kya karte ho?'

shots.desc: Mamta's face as the voices build, then cut dead.
shots.light: Window key from the side, 6:1, her eyes catch the bulb's warm catchlight when the voices cut
shots.notes: Hard audio cut to silence before Papa speaks.
shots.audio: Muffled voices build, then stop. PAPA (O.S.): 'Ajaa...Maa se mil le'

shots.desc: Mamta leaves her bags where she stands and walks toward her mother's room.
shots.light: Soft wide wash; she walks into the darker corridor
shots.notes: The bags stay in the middle of the room: she hasn't decided to stay.

title: Scene 8 - THE CHAIN - INT. House (Mother's Room) - Day | LIGHT: Day int mother's room, a single small window with a thin cotton curtain, soft, cool 6000K on muted blue walls, low key 6:1, sickroom pallor

shots.desc: Through the doorway: a small bed in the corner of a room with faded blue walls; Mother lies weak and pale, and a big smile spreads as she sees Mamta.
shots.light: Soft curtain light on the blue walls and the bed in the corner, 6000K, room mostly in soft shadow, mother's pale face the brightest point
shots.notes: PLANT: the blue walls pay off in Shot 184 (moonlight) and the river, Shot 187. Paint the walls a muted blue so the moonlight can turn them into water.

shots.desc: Mother slowly gestures her to come closer.
shots.light: Soft window key from above the bed, pale and flat on Mother's skin, a weak catchlight, 4:1: fragility

shots.desc: Mamta walks to the bed; Mother reaches out with difficulty and holds her wrist.
shots.light: Soft window side light on both, 5:1, Mamta's face on the darker side

shots.desc: Mother's frail hand around Mamta's wrist.
shots.light: Soft light on the hands, Mother's skin almost translucent
shots.notes: MOTIF: HANDS. PLANT: the same framing becomes the chain in Shot 53.

shots.desc: FLASH: a heavy metal chain wrapped around Mamta's wrist where the hand was.
shots.light: Same framing, the window light cut to a hard narrow slash (a flag in) and a metallic specular on the chain, cold: the flash in light
shots.notes: SAME FRAMING as Shot 52, hard cut, light drops. Practical chain prop, no VFX.

shots.desc: Mamta jerks her arm free.
shots.light: Back to soft window light, a flicker as she moves through it

shots.desc: Mother's confused, hurt face.
shots.light: Soft key, a weak catchlight, 4:1; the confusion lives in her eyes

shots.desc: Mamta sits down awkwardly beside her and tucks Mother's hand under the blanket.
shots.light: Soft window side, 5:1, Mamta keeps her back to the window, face in shade
shots.notes: Tucking the hand away is a quiet rejection.

shots.desc: Papa at the door lets out a big sigh and leaves without answering.
shots.light: Papa in the doorway, backlit by the corridor, his face murky
shots.notes: His silence is the answer.

shots.desc: Mother gestures with her eyes toward the door: go and check on him. Mamta nods and leaves.
shots.light: Mother's eyes catch a small window catchlight, the rest soft

title: Scene 9 - DISTANCE - INT. House (Drawing Room/Corridor) - Day | LIGHT: Day int drawing room/corridor, the same setup as Scene 7 seen from the dark corridor, low key, window light far away

shots.desc: From the corridor, across the drawing room: Papa in the distance wiping tears; Mamta stops in the foreground, soft.
shots.light: Papa in a soft window pool across the room, Mamta in the foreground in corridor darkness: the light between them is the distance
shots.notes: Long lens = the distance between them. She doesn't cross it.

shots.desc: Mamta turns and walks toward her room instead.
shots.light: She turns into the dark corridor, losing the key

title: Scene 10 - THE TALLY - INT. House (Mamta's Room) - Day | LIGHT: Day int Mamta's room, one window with an iron grille, hard afternoon sun broken by the grille + an overcast soft fill, 5600K, contrasty (8:1): her prison, now in daylight

shots.desc: Mamta's old room: she sets her suitcase on the bed. The almirah from the flash stands against the wall.
shots.light: Grille-shadow pattern on the floor and bed from the hard sun, deep room shadows, 8:1
shots.notes: Same almirah as Shot 38. PLANT: this framing returns at night for the birth, Shot 150.

shots.desc: She carries a big pile of clothes to the almirah and places it inside, leaving the doors open.
shots.light: She crosses through the grille pattern, light and shadow sliding over her

shots.desc: As she turns, her eyes stop on the inside of one door.
shots.light: Side light from the window, 6:1, the almirah interior falls dark

shots.desc: Carvings inside the wooden door: tally marks counting months, a big F with 28 days in tally, M below it with 31, then April, and the count for May stopping at twelve.
shots.light: A hard raking side light (a small LED with a snoot) across the carvings so every groove has a shadow edge, 5600K: the marks must be readable
shots.notes: PAYOFF of Shot 34: this was the scraping. PLANT: the count stopping at May 12 pays off in Shot 152. Make the marks legible to the audience.

shots.desc: Mamta's fingers brush across the texture of the carvings.
shots.light: Raking light, finger shadows in the grooves
shots.notes: MOTIF: HANDS.

shots.desc: Mamta's eyes begin to well up.
shots.light: Window side key, 6:1, a wet catchlight in her eyes

shots.desc: She reflexively shuts the door halfway, hiding the marks, and looks toward the doorway.
shots.light: The almirah door swings, cutting the light across her
shots.notes: She hides the past from him: a reflex learned here.

shots.desc: Papa standing in the doorframe, prescription in hand.
shots.light: Papa in the doorframe, backlit by the corridor, half silhouette
shots.notes: MOTIF: FRAMES; he is always in doorways.
shots.audio: PAPA: 'Ye kuch davaiya khatam ho rahi hai, mein leke aata hoon.'

shots.desc: Mamta, already moving to escape the house.
shots.light: Side key, 6:1, already turning away from the light

shots.desc: She shuts the almirah door fully.
shots.light: Raking light on the shutting door, then it goes dark

title: Scene 11 - WHITE COATS - EXT. Small Town - Day | LIGHT: Day ext small-town street, overcast, soft top light, grey and cool 6500K; then the white coats overexposing the frame: white as threat

shots.desc: A small-town street: Mamta walks slowly, folding the prescription.
shots.light: Overcast soft top light, flat grey street, 6500K
shots.notes: Flat overcast daylight; the town is as grey as the house.

shots.desc: She tucks the folded prescription into her bag.
shots.light: Soft top light on the paper

shots.desc: A big group of medical students in white lab coats suddenly flows around her from every side.
shots.light: White coats reflect the overcast and push +1 stop over her; the frame brightens unpleasantly
shots.notes: Cast 25-30 extras; white coats are the only bright thing in frame.

shots.desc: Her view whips left, right, forward, back: white everywhere.
shots.light: Whip pans across sun-catching white coats, clipping highlights, hard daylight
shots.notes: Panic beat, so handheld. White = Dev = loss.

shots.desc: Mamta frozen on the spot while white coats stream past her, soft and out of focus.
shots.light: She is under-exposed by 1 stop relative to the bright white blur around her, cold 6500K: drowned in white
shots.notes: Isolate her on 85. Street sound drains out and the melody creeps in underneath (bridge).
shots.audio: Music: 'Meri aas leyi angdaaiyan' (Punjabi; RIGHTS FLAG) fades in

title: Scene 12 - CORE MEMORY: THE SHEETS - EXT. Hospital - Day | LIGHT: Day ext hospital backyard memory: hard midday sun backlighting rows of sheets, blown 2 stops, warm 4500K, glowing translucency, high key: the only bright memory

shots.desc: A hospital backyard full of white bedsheets drying on lines, fluttering. Dev (22, the same white lab coat) and young Mamta run through them, laughing.
shots.light: Hard backlit sun through rows of white sheets, overexposed by 2 stops, warm 4500K, figures glowing through the fabric, haze
shots.notes: The only sunlit, overexposed memory: happiness as white light. PLANT: the fluttering sheets rhyme with the delivery-room curtain, Shot 159. Shoot in hard sun; a wind machine keeps the sheets moving.
shots.audio: Music: 'Meri aas leyi angdaaiyan' (Punjabi; RIGHTS FLAG): 'Meri aas leyi angdaaiyan / Jaag jawani jaag jaag'

shots.desc: Dev grabs Mamta's arm and slowly pulls her close.
shots.light: The sun as a rim on both heads, sheets glowing behind, a large white bounce for the faces, 2:1
shots.audio: Music: 'Meri aas leyi angdaaiyan' (Punjabi; RIGHTS FLAG): 'Jagaan diyan rutt aayiyaan / Saagar vich aj odh uchaale,'

shots.desc: Mamta throws a bedsheet over Dev's face, giggles and runs away.
shots.light: Backlit sun through the sheet thrown over Dev's face, his face lost in the glow
shots.notes: WITHHOLD Dev's face: it stays behind sheets, backs and soft focus until the river, Shot 191.
shots.audio: Music: 'Meri aas leyi angdaaiyan' (Punjabi; RIGHTS FLAG): 'Aj mere supne matvaale, / Aj alsaya ang ang,'

shots.desc: Hide and seek between the rows of sheets.
shots.light: Strobing light as they cross sheet after sheet, hard backlight, flaring
shots.audio: Music: 'Meri aas leyi angdaaiyan' (Punjabi; RIGHTS FLAG): 'Akhiyan meri nashiaayiyan / Meri aas leyi angdaaiyan' + MAMTA (V.O.): 'Mummy Papa se kab baat karoge'

shots.desc: Through a translucent sheet: Dev's silhouette searching for her.
shots.light: Dev as a silhouette shadow on the sheet, the sun directly behind the fabric
shots.audio: Music: 'Meri aas leyi angdaaiyan' (Punjabi; RIGHTS FLAG): 'Vagg ni vaye mehka matiye,' + DEV (V.O.): 'Exams khatam hote hi...'

shots.desc: They find each other and hold close, slowly leaning in.
shots.light: A glowing rim from the backlight, the bounce gives soft frontal fill, 2:1, warm 4500K
shots.audio: Music: 'Meri aas leyi angdaaiyan' (Punjabi; RIGHTS FLAG): 'Hass po kaliye, hass pi patiye,' + MAMTA (V.O.): 'Waqt nikla jaa raha hai Dev'

shots.desc: A fluttering sheet covers their faces; two silhouettes share a gentle kiss behind it.
shots.light: Pure silhouettes against the sun-lit sheet, the kiss as a shadow play
shots.notes: The kiss is implied behind the sheet, per the Brief.
shots.audio: Music: 'Meri aas leyi angdaaiyan' (Punjabi; RIGHTS FLAG): 'Aj mere baagan vich chalke, / Aap bahaar aayiyaan / Meri paas leyi angdaaiyan'

shots.desc: Present-day Mamta (35), smiling, grabs the sheet in front of her and pulls it away to look at Dev.

title: Scene 15 - CORE MEMORY: THE BRIDE - INT. House (Mamta's Room) - Night / Afternoon (cont.) | LIGHT: Night int memory (bride): a bare 100W tungsten bulb overhead + vanity mirror bulbs, 2700K, hard and oppressive, red dominant; returns to afternoon window light on Papa's call

shots.notes: MOTIF: RED fills the screen, the motif's peak. Papa's voice calling bridges back to the present.

shots.desc: Afternoon again: Papa stands at the doorframe with a plate of food; Mamta turns with a jolt.

shots.notes: MOTIF: FRAMES: Papa in a doorway again.

shots.desc: Papa, hesitant.
shots.light: Papa in soft afternoon spill, 4:1
shots.audio: PAPA: 'Woh..mein keh raha tha..aaj maa ko khana tu khilade, usse acha lagega.'

shots.light: Moonlike cool edge on Mother sleeping, the rest dark

title: Scene 19 - THE FIGHT - INT. House (Drawing Room) - Late Evening | LIGHT: Late evening int drawing room, a single overhead green-cool tubelight + a dim table lamp, hard, low key 8:1, 4300K green vs 3200K: the fight under the tube

shots.desc: Mamta.
shots.light: Mamta cool tubelight key, 8:1

shots.light: Papa warm key

shots.light: Fog backlit by the moon, the figure a soft silhouette

shots.desc: Mamta's eyes squint, then fly open.
shots.light: A cool moonlit rim, a faint catchlight in widening eyes

shots.desc: Dev on the shore: tall, a gentle smile, tears glinting in his eyes, his arm extended toward her.
shots.light: Dev backlit by the moon, a soft cool front fill reveals his face fully for the first time, tears glinting
shots.notes: REVEAL: Dev's face clearly seen for the first time (withheld since Shot 78).
shots.audio: A faint echo of the melody (no lyrics)

shots.desc: The boat drifts past the shore; Mamta turns to keep looking at him.
shots.light: Moon rim on Mamta turning away
shots.audio: MAMTA: 'Mujhe jaane do Dev, ye naav mujhe bohot dur le aayi hai...'

shots.desc: Dev fades into the fog and the distance.
shots.light: Dev dissolves into backlit fog

shots.desc: A child's crying fills the space; Mamta looks left and right, her anxiety rising.
shots.light: A soft cool key, eyes darting
shots.notes: The baby is heard, never seen (see Shot 152).

shots.desc: The crying calms into a giggle, then happy play; with longing but a subtle smile, Mamta turns to face the other way.
shots.light: The key softens and slightly warms on her face (a 5000K bounce), a subtle smile: acceptance
shots.notes: She lets the child go.

shots.desc: The boat stops mid-water; she pushes water back with her hands, but it won't move.
shots.light: Wide silver water, haze

shots.desc: A taut rope ties the boat to the shore.
shots.light: A moon specular along the rope

shots.desc: She pulls on the rope a couple of times; the boat doesn't budge.
shots.light: Soft cool key on her hands
shots.notes: MOTIF: HANDS.

shots.desc: The clouds clear: Jagdish on the shore in his wedding sherwani.
shots.light: Haze clears: Jagdish a soft silhouette in the backlight
shots.notes: Wedding clothes rhyme with Shot 29.

shots.desc: Jagdish walks down and unties the knot on the shore.
shots.light: Moon rim on his hands at the knot
shots.notes: MOTIF: HANDS: his hands free her.

shots.desc: The boat floats free; Jagdish and Mamta look at each other with subtle smiles and tears in their eyes.
shots.light: Both in soft moon rim, the faces dimly lit

shots.desc: Jagdish recedes into the distance and disappears.
shots.light: Jagdish fades into backlit haze

shots.desc: Mamta turns forward again; a soft motherly voice echoes and she looks up.
shots.light: Soft moon fill as she looks up

shots.desc: Mother and Father on the shore, hands folded, eyes full of tears.
shots.light: The parents backlit by the moon, faces dim

shots.desc: Mother, hands folded.
shots.light: Mother in a soft cool fill, tears glinting
shots.notes: PAYOFF of the title (Draupadi staked in a dice game) and of the student's question, Shot 14.
shots.audio: MOTHER: 'Hume maaf karde beta! Samaaj ke iss juen mein jab khud ko haar gaye, toh humne tujhe daav par laga diya'

shots.desc: Mamta frozen, neither happy nor sad, lips barely moving.
shots.light: Same framing as the bidaai MCU but now a soft cool moon key, a calm 3:1 instead of the hard wedding light
shots.notes: SAME FRAMING as Shot 30: the same blank face, but now she is the one leaving. She leaves them to God and does not forgive them herself.

shots.desc: From behind: Mamta turns away from them and floats on toward the horizon and the rising sun.
shots.light: Warm sunrise breaks behind the horizon through haze: a 3200K backlight, the ratio opens; the first warm light of the film
shots.notes: The first warm light in the film. Blue hour into sunrise; shoot at dawn.
shots.audio: Music: a sparse, warm theme enters

title: Scene 28 - THE FLOWER - INT. House (Mother's Room) - Sunrise | LIGHT: Sunrise int mother's room, the first warm window light of the film, a 3200K low sun through haze, 2:1, soft and open: release

shots.desc: Sunrise light fills the room: Mamta sits by the bed with her head on Mother's chest; Mother's hand rests on her head, a subtle smile on her face, her chest not moving.
shots.light: Low warm sun through the window, haze beams, a 2:1 soft wash, the faces gently lit
shots.notes: Same framing as Shot 184, now warm. The first warm interior in the film. SCRIPT FLAG: the script says 'VILLAGE HOUSE'; treated as the same house.

shots.desc: Mother's hand on Mamta's head.
shots.light: Warm sun on the hands, soft skin tones
shots.notes: MOTIF: HANDS: the hand that gave the child away now rests in blessing.

shots.desc: Mother's still face; her chest doesn't rise.
shots.light: Warm, soft light on Mother's still face, a peaceful glow
shots.notes: Death played quietly: no reaction cue.

shots.desc: Father comes in, sits on the other side of the bed and places his hand on Mamta's head too.
shots.light: Warm sun as a backlight on Papa as he enters, a soft front bounce

shots.desc: The camera slowly tracks out from the three of them, bringing into frame a flower growing through a crack in the wall.
shots.light: The dolly out reveals the sunbeam landing on the flower in the wall crack, its petals backlit warm
shots.notes: PAYOFF of Shot 5: uprooted, the plant still flowered. Closing image. The flower is a practical plant set into a crack in the wall.

shots.desc: FADE TO WHITE; title card.
shots.light: N/A
shots.notes: Title card: the only on-screen text, in a simple serif.
shots.audio: Music: final note; silence. Text: 'DRAUPADI SE DRAUPADI TAK'
